verses.text: Ixlajwi chi, ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi': --Ixik t'a winh rey chi', tzalan t'a winh: Icha wal tik yalan Jehová ko Diosal a onh hebreo onh tik: Chab'at in chonhab' tik yik tz'och heb' ejmelal t'ayin.
Tato manh ol a chab'at heb', tato ol a yamnhejoch waan heb',
ol kot wowal, ol wak'anelta yab'il t'a nok' he molb'etzal nok', ol cham nok' yuj yab'il chi', haton nok' chej, nok' wakax, nok' kamello, nok' b'uru, nok' kalnel yet' nok' chiwa.
Palta ol in ch'oxo' to ch'ok yel heb' israel t'a wichanh, yuj chi' malaj junok nok' snok' heb' ol chamok, xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a winh.
Ix yalankan sk'ual Jehová chi', ix yalani: --Ha k'ik'an swak'kot jun yaelal chi', xchi.
Haxo t'a junxo k'u chi', ix yak'ankot yab'il Jehová t'a nok' nok' chi'. Tzijtum nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb' aj Egipto chi' ix chami, haxo pax heb' aj israel, malaj junok nok' yik heb' ix chami.

T'a elanhchamel ix b'at schekan iljok winh rey tato malaj nok' yik heb' israel chi' ix chami. Wach'chom malaj junok nok' ix chami, palta ix spitejxi spensar winh rey chi', maj aktajel heb' israel chi' yuj winh.

Ixlajwi chi, ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés yet' t'a winhaj Aarón: --Ixikek, ik'ekkot junok wotz k'een tik'aq'uil taanh t'a yol junok horno. Ha ach tik ach Moisés tza tzipk'e k'een t'a chaanh t'a yichanh winh rey chi'.
Icha chi', ol saklemkanb'at k'een icha pokok t'a masanil yol smakb'en Egipto, yuj k'een ol k'e yab'il yaxk'a t'a masanil anima chi' yet' t'a nok' nok', xchi Jehová.

Ixlajwi chi, ix b'at winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Aarón yik'kot k'een taanh t'a junok horno, ix b'at heb' winh yil winh rey chi'. Ayik ix k'och heb' winh t'a yichanh winh, ix stzipank'e k'een winhaj Moisés t'a chaanh. Ixlajwi chi', ix pitzwik'e yab'il yaxk'a t'a masanil anima chi' yet' t'a masanil nok' nok'.
Haxo heb' ay tas tzuji yuj yalani, majxo yal-laj sch'oxan sb'a heb' t'a yichanh winhaj Moisés chi', yujto ya ay heb' yuj yab'il yaxk'a icha yaj masanil heb' anima t'a Egipto chi'.
Ix pitb'ixiel spensar winh rey chi' yuj Jehová, maj schalaj yab' winh tas ix yal heb' winh chawanh chi', icha ix yutej yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés: --Spet ex k'e waan k'ik'an, b'at ex lolon t'a winh rey chi', tzeyalan t'a winh: Icha wal tik yalan Jehová ko Diosal a onh hebreo onh tik: Aktejel heb' in chonhab' yik b'at och heb' ejmelal t'ayin.

Ha t'a jun pekti' tik ol wak'kot juntzanh yaelal tik t'a ib'anh yet' t'a yib'anh heb' ay yopisio het'ok yet' t'a yib'anh heb' a chonhab', yik wach' tzojtakejeli to manhxa junok mach lajan spoder icha in tik t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik.
Tato syal in k'ool, tzin ch'ox wipalil t'ayach, swak'anoch yaelal t'a ib'anh yet' t'a yib'anh masanil heb' anima t'a a makb'en tik. Syal tzex in satel t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik.
Okxo, manto ol ach in satel-laj, yujto ix ach wak'och t'a opisio yuj in ch'oxanel in poder yuj tas ol ach wutok, yik te niwan ol aj in b'inaj t'a skal masanil anima t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik.
Wach'chom tzijtum yaelal tzin ch'ox ila', palta tza pitejnhej a b'a, hanheja' max aktejel-laj in chonhab' tik.

Yuj chi, a k'ik'an yab' wal icha hora tik, swak'anem k'een sakb'at t'a yib'anh chonhab' tik. Mantalaj b'aj tz'em k'een sakb'at yelxo wal niwak icha k'een tz'em chi' yiktax ix el yich chonhab' Egipto tik.

Yuj chi', al t'a heb' winh a chekab' to a masanil nok' molb'etzal nok' yet' masanil tas ay t'a skal a munlajel to tz'ochkan t'a yoltak lechpat, yujto ayik ol ja k'een niwak sakb'at chi', masanil nok' nok' yet' masanil anima malaj yenhul, ol cham yuj k'een, xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a winh.

Ay heb' winh ay yopisio yet' winh rey, ix xiwkank'ei ayik ix yab'an heb' yuj tas ix yal Jehová. Yuj chi, ix yak'k'e yenhul nok' smolb'etzal snok' heb' winh. Ix ochpaxkan masanil schekab' heb' winh t'a yoltak lechpat chi'.
Ay juntzanhxo heb' maj yak'och t'a sk'ol tas ix yal Jehová chi', ix kan nok' smolb'etzal nok' yet' heb' schekab' heb' t'a ichnhejta'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés: --Ik'chaanh a k'ab' yik tz'em k'een niwak sakb'at t'a yib'anh masanil anima, t'a yib'anh masanil nok' nok' yet' t'a yib'anh masanil tas awab'il ay t'a yol smakb'en Egipto tik, xchi.
Yuj chi' ix yik'anchaanh sk'okoch winhaj Moisés chi', ix mak'waj k'u, ix ek' kopoljok lheb'lon, ix kot k'een niwak sakb'at t'a masanil sat lum t'a yol yik Egipto chi' yuj Jehová.

Maxtzak ochlaj waan yem k'een sakb'at yet' smak'waj k'u yet' yek' kopoljok lheb'lon. Malaj ton b'aj ix b'inaj yak'an junelok sakb'at t'a yol yik Egipto t'a yalanhtaxo icha jun owal sakb'at ix yak' chi'.

Masanil tastak ay t'a Egipto chi', ix ixtaxb'at yuj k'een niwak sakb'at ix yak' chi'. Ix cham heb' anima yet' nok' nok' aykan t'a spatiktak pat yet' masanil tastak ay t'a skaltak munlajel ix lajwikanel yuj k'een, yet' masanil te te' ix laj ixtaxkanb'at te'.
Haxonhej t'a yol yik Gosén b'aj ayek' heb' israel, malaj wal junok k'otanh k'een sakb'at chi' ix emi.
Yuj chi' ix schekan winh rey awtajxikot heb' winh chawanh chi', ix yalan winh: --Toxo ix nachajel wuuj tiknaik to a in ay in mul yet' in chonhab' tik. Palta a Jehová, te tojolnhej syutej.

Toxo ix ek' yib'anh smak'waj k'u yet' yem k'een niwak sakb'at. Yuj chi', manhxo ol wik'ek' he tiempo, syal he b'at b'aj syal he k'ool, anhej jun, komonok tz'el t'a he k'ol tze k'an t'a Jehová yik syik'el jun yaelal tik, xchi winh rey chi'.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Moisés chi' t'a winh: --Anhej wal tzin elkan t'a yol chonhab' tik, tzin mojb'an in k'ab' in lesalwi t'a Jehová, tzin k'anan t'ay yik syaktan yak'ankot k'een sakb'at tik, yik manhxo ol mak'waj k'u, yik wach' snachajel uuj to yik Jehová yaj masanil yol yib'anhk'inal tik.
Palta wojtak sik'lab'il to a ach tik yet' heb' ay yopisio het'ok, manta yelk'och Jehová Dios t'a yol he sat, xchi winh.
Ha jantak tas awab'il, icha anh lino yet' ixim kebada, masanil ix ixtaxkanb'ati, yujto a ixim kebada ayxo sat ixim, hanheja' anh lino ayxo xumakil anh.
Haxo pax ixim trigo yet' ixim kenteno, malaj tas ix ik'an ixim, yujto tzak'anxo tz'elul ixim.

Ayik ix lajwi slolon winhaj Moisés yet' winh rey chi', ix el winh t'a yol chonhab' chi', ix yik'anchaanh sk'ab' winh, ix lesalwi winh t'a Jehová. Ha wal t'a jun rato chi', ix wanaj yem k'een sakb'at yet' nhab' yet' smak'waj k'u.
Haxo ix yilan winh rey to maxtzak emlaj nhab', maxtzak emlaj k'een sakb'at, manhxalaj k'u sk'anhi, hanheja' ix ochxi smul winh, ix pitb'ixiel spensar winh yet' heb' ay yopisio yet'ok.
Yuj chi', majxo aktajel-laj chonhab' Israel chi' yuj winh, icha ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
